title: Director and Managing Partner at Verizon Connect Sees Samsara Maintaining Its Telematics Leadership and Growth
expert: Director and managing partner at Verizon Connect (competitor); ~20 years in telematics; sees Samsara in Fortune 100/500/1,000 deal flow
verdict: A Verizon Connect executive sees Samsara in 85%–90% of the competitive opportunities he works, though pricing changes have caused some churn.

Competition & share: 🟢 Samsara in 85%–90% of competitive opportunities (first-hand, competitor view); matches Jefferies 'wins on platform' (SB #62604): consistent. → Tenet 4 (platform moat) ↑

🔴 Pricing changes have contributed to churn in some accounts, and OEM-embedded telematics is a headwind; Jefferies saw license cost scrutinised at renewals (SB #62601): consistent. → Tenet 1 (enterprise expansion) ↓
Enterprise expansion ($100K+ cohort): 🟢 Cameras lift ARPU to about \$50–\$75 per month (estimate) in the installed base; first read. → Tenet 1 (enterprise expansion) ↑
Emerging products / white space: 🟡 Trailer tracking growing 12%–15% (estimate), possibly 20%–30% with consolidation, while ELD growth is single digits, if that; first read. → Tenet 2 (emerging products) ↑

characterization_changed: Very Positive: the only first-hand figure is deal presence (85%–90%); the expert also cites pricing-driven churn, OEM-embedded competition and single-digit ELD growth.
changes: Win presence: Samsara in 85%–90% of competitive deals vs Jefferies 'wins on platform; competitors aggressive on price in large enterprise deals' (SB #62604): consistent.
Churn: pricing-related churn vs Jefferies check that license cost is a focus at renewals (SB #62601): consistent.
First read on camera ARPU uplift (\$50–\$75 per month) and trailer-tracking growth (12%–15%); no earlier expert call or stored row.
thesis_impact: Tenet 4 (platform moat): ↑ — present in 85%–90% of competitive deals; OEM-embedded telematics is the stated threat.
Tenet 1 (enterprise expansion): → — camera upsell to \$50–\$75 per month ARPU vs pricing-driven churn.
Tenet 2 (emerging products): ↑ — trailer tracking 12%–15% growth (estimate), more than 60 million U.S. trailers.
